title: The Lateness Clock for Courtesy Waivers
content:
For an Apartment Home Lease courtesy waiver, the lateness clock starts on the period's due date, except that when the latest ACH autopay payment return on the lease is dated within the period (on or after its due date and before the next due date) the clock starts on the date of that return, and when no such draft was returned and the due date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday the clock starts on the following Monday.

## Questions answered

**Which return is looked at?** The most recent return of an ACH autopay draft recorded on the lease — one return, the latest of the lease's returned autopay drafts. If that return is dated on or after the period's due date and before the next due date, the clock starts on its date. Returns of payments made by other instruments are not looked at.

**What if the latest returned autopay draft falls in another month?** Then no draft was returned within the period, and the clock starts on the due date — or on the following Monday when the due date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday.

**How is the weekday of the due date read?** From the calendar: a due date on Saturday 1 March 2025 moves the clock to Monday 3 March 2025; a due date on Sunday 1 June 2025 moves it to Monday 2 June 2025. A due date on any weekday from Monday to Friday leaves the clock on the due date.

## Summary

| Latest returned autopay draft dated within the period | Due date on a Saturday or Sunday | Lateness clock starts on |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | the date of that return |
| No | Yes | the following Monday |
| No | No | the due date |

*Hypothetical:* period due Saturday 1 November 2025, latest returned autopay draft dated 4 November 2025 — the clock starts on 4 November, the date of that return.
